annotations.text:
Four directions on the v4 system.
Ground #0A1712, mint only on the live element, brass only on a defensible number, pill terminals throughout.
Wordmark is constant across all four — Apfel Grotezk Mittel 500, -0.012em — so the comparison is the mark, not the type.
My pick: B. Say the word and I'll cut the production SVGs (mark, lockup, favicon set) into public/ and wire the header.
